notablePrerequisites:
Locust Swarm and Marwyn have at least one counter on them.
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Locust Swarm until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {G}, untapping it.
Repeat.
